policy.mapping: Original semantic links for exact DJ-FX bank names Echo/Distortion only. No FFT trigger, no aliases/families/31 hidden definitions inferred. Deck1→left,Deck2→right,Master→master once; other assignments are explicitly unsupported.

policy.reducedMotion: Suppress all Echo trails and geometric Distortion warp; retain static distortion colour and observable semantic metadata. No generated flash or zoom.
policy.limitations: No exact Serato transfer/parameters/order/tail claim; channel knob FX, stems, Deck3/4 and Sampler links are not mapped. Audio graph/output is never mutated by this bridge.

checks.name: JSON roundtrip preserves only intended timing scalars without taps, armed state or effect changes

policy.estimator: First two accepted taps anchor the range; median of the last5 normalized intervals. Later quarter/half/single/double/bar intervals fold by .25,.5,1,2,4 toward that anchor, within25% deviation.
policy.idle: After more than max(8seconds,4.5anchor intervals), start a fresh first-tap sequence while retaining any established manual BPM until a new valid pair.
policy.invalid: Nonfinite/nonmonotonic timestamps are ignored. Initial intervals outside150..3000ms restart the first-tap sequence. Later outlier intervals do not alter the held clock or last accepted beat.
policy.persistence: Only {mode,bpm}; armed flag, taps, intervals and timestamps are session-local.

scope: Actual AudioEngine/Echo Worklets and real PCM repeat intervals; actual engine.setRate and semantic Video link metadata. Deterministic controller taps prove timing-mode integration, not real human tap gestures. Test-only measurement worklet emits silent output. Native hardware/vendor response and UI gestures require separate acceptance.
